## This work (Р-232)

Each unit has its own `book_id` (see the unit). Records of a book — `<book_id>/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/<book_id>/<kinds>/`; shared records (rules, tables, occupations, skills, spells, tomes, weapons, creatures, cities) — `coc:<kind>:<slug>` in `kb/<kinds>/`. Before creating anything shared, Grep `kb/` by Russian and English names: if a record exists, change it only through proposals (`checks/20261114-ru-more/proposals-<unit>.json`). Dice with lowercase d (Р-27), metric units (Р-64; printed titles with measures go to `aliases`, Р-229). Keep scratch files in `.cache/<unit>/`, never in the repo root. Coverage: `checks/20261114-ru-more/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «Не взято»; no git.

### Cthulhu Dark Ages (units ages-*)
- Book `temnye-veka-tri-stsenariya-ru` (despite the file name it is the whole Cthulhu Dark Ages 7e book, fan translation, edition `trusted`): the Russian text is the source — do NOT set `translated`; printed page = physical − 1 (`offset` set). The English 7e original is registered as `cthulhu-dark-ages-en` (`pipeline/source/pages.py show cthulhu-dark-ages-en <page>`): use it to check numbers and translator slips (`corrections`/`errata`), and for `name.en`. Official Russian forms of the base win over the fan forms (fan forms → `aliases`).
- Everything of this book has `axes.era` ["dark-ages"], `ruleset` "core". Rules of the era (changes to the core rules, new skills, money, armour, combat, magic, sanity in the Dark Ages) — `coc:rule:dark-ages-*` / `coc:table:dark-ages-*`, each linking with `refs` to the core rule it changes; never edit core rules, only proposals adding a ref to the Dark Ages variant. Era occupations — `coc:occupation:<slug>` with era dark-ages (if a 1920s occupation of the same name exists, make a separate record `<slug>-dark-ages` and link both). New skills of the era — `coc:skill:*` (Grep first). Weapons of the era — `coc:weapon:*` (Grep first: sword, spear, etc. exist; add `source_variants` through proposals where numbers differ). Bestiary — creatures: shared `coc:creature:*` if new, else book records with `instance_of`. Mythos tomes and spells of the era — shared. Totburg — a fictional town: shared city `coc:location:totburg` (type город), its places under it. Historical people (Р-42) only as text unless they have stats.

### Solo adventures (units tide, flames, dark) — Р-230
ONE scenario record with `solo: true`; every numbered paragraph in full, as printed, in a table «Абзацы» in `tables` (columns «№», «Текст», «Переходы»; checks and outcomes stay in the paragraph text; transitions as the last line «Переходы: …»). Extract the paragraphs with a script from the text layer (or OCR text), verify numbering 1…N has no gaps or duplicates, spot-check against page images, list unreadable paragraphs in the coverage file. `steps` — big branches and endings with refs. Characters, creatures, places, items, handouts, maps and pregens — ordinary records. Model: `kb/books/naedine-s-pomekhami-ru/scenarios/naedine-s-pomekhami.json` and its book folder. Pregens already in the base (Grep the pregen book ids `koshmarnyy-priliv-pregens-ru`, `naedine-s-tmoy-pregens-ru`, `startovyy-nabor-pregens-ru`) — link to them, do not duplicate; changes through proposals.
